evidence: We use predictive models, which analyze historical statistical data about various risk characteristics that drive loss experience for many of our Standard Commercial Lines and Standard Personal Lines products. Some of these models incorporate traditional artificial intelligence ('AI').
We employ traditional AI methods, such as machine learning, to increase organizational efficiency and improve decision-making speed and accuracy.
We are increasingly leveraging general-purpose and industry-trained generative AI solutions that use large language models to improve internal process efficiency and effectiveness.
To enhance underwriting scalability, risk management, and claims handling, we are actively developing and executing artificial intelligence use cases.

Further leveraging the use of data analytics and technology, including general-purpose, industry-trained, and agentic artificial intelligence solutions, to drive operational efficiency and improved underwriting and claim outcomes.
ai_positioning.summary: SIGI intègre l'IA en interne pour optimiser ses opérations d'assurance : modèles prédictifs pour le pricing et la souscription, machine learning pour l'efficacité organisationnelle, et IA générative pour les processus internes. L'entreprise développe activement des cas d'usage IA pour améliorer la scalabilité et les résultats de sinistres.
